tasks.label: Preview Cards
args: python3 -m http.server 8000 & preview_pid=$!; trap 'kill "$preview_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM; until curl --silent --fail http://localhost:8000/tests/preview.html >/dev/null; do sleep 0.1; done; xdg-open http://localhost:8000/tests/preview.html; wait "$preview_pid"
